cause: Idle preview used saved task target both as detector filter and unconditional Color label, including missing detections.
fix: Idle color preview searches all six saved color thresholds and shows the selected detected color; no detection displays --. B-station and standalone alignment remain target-specific.
selection: Smallest valid candidate across colors; each color retains its calibrated area/HSV limits and per-color contour policy.
